Filings: FY2024 Form 10-K (accession 0001744489-24-000276) and the 2025 proxy statement filed January 23, 2025 (accession 0001744489-25-000059), both read on www.sec.gov. WALT DISNEY is deceased. The proxy's stock ownership section lists only Vanguard and BlackRock as 5% holders and no Disney family member, trust or foundation, so family is null. HOLDER DATES: the proxy cites each firm's Schedule 13G/A without giving its date or as-of date, so asOf is null. DIVIDENDS: Disney resumed dividends in fiscal 2024 after paying none in fiscal 2023 and 2022. The dividend and stock-comp figures are both $1,366 million; this is a coincidence of the filing, and each was checked separately. STOCK COMP is net of $201 million capitalized. GEOGRAPHY: the fiscal 2024 total of $91,361 million matches consolidated revenue; the 2022 column in the same table shows a separate content-license early-termination adjustment.
